title: A bulkhead for the inventory service

task.text: Cap how many calls one dependency may have in flight, so a stall cannot eat every thread.
Implement `Bulkhead(String name, int maxConcurrent)` and `<T> T call(Supplier<T> op)`. `BulkheadFullException` is given.

items: Up to `maxConcurrent` calls run `op` at the same time, each on its own caller's thread.
When the bulkhead is full, `call` throws `new BulkheadFullException(name)` **immediately**; it must not block or queue, and `op` must not run.
A permit is returned when `op` finishes, whether it returns or throws; the exception reaches the caller unchanged.

checks.title: A call under the limit runs
A full bulkhead rejects by name
A full bulkhead does not affect another
Racing callers never exceed the limit

hints.text: A bulkhead is a counter of free slots plus the discipline to give each slot back. Which `java.util.concurrent` type counts permits and can refuse without blocking?
Hold a `Semaphore` created with `maxConcurrent`. Use the non-blocking `tryAcquire()`; reject if it says no. Run `op` in a `try` and release the permit in `finally`.
